cases.input: contour-decision.json records all six candidate decisions, five unassigned roots and zero allocated identifiers.
cases.expect: The settled boundary validates and the decision record is accepted.

cases.input: A single combined ItemDefinition root is proposed covering both commercial type and engineering definition.
cases.expect: The combined root is rejected and the WM-OBJ-002 / WM-OBJ-018 split is retained.

cases.input: Occurrence is promoted to a root with globally unique identity outside any EBOM baseline.
cases.expect: The promotion is rejected; occurrence stays a baseline-scoped contained identity in WM-OBJ-019.

cases.input: Variant, SerializedItem, FirmwareRelease or SBOM is re-declared a missing root despite WM-OBJ-017, WM-OBJ-001, WM-SFT-008 and WM-SFT-012 existing.
cases.expect: The reopening is rejected and the rejectedRootClaims record is cited.

cases.input: A model identifier is assigned to any of the five unassigned candidates.
cases.expect: The allocation is rejected; modelId and registryId stay null.

cases.input: An unassigned candidate is cited as a resolvable authority for lot effectivity or as-built composition.
cases.expect: The citation is rejected and the unresolvedReferences hold is reported.

cases.input: Every expectedCode used by any fixture resolves to a code in error-codes.json.
cases.expect: Registry resolution succeeds for all negative fixtures.

cases.input: A fixture case omits target, violates or closesDefect.
cases.expect: The fixture file fails validation.

cases.input: Every candidate, profile, policy and README artifact carries publicationHold true and canonicalPublishable false.
cases.expect: The publication hold is uniformly asserted.

cases.input: An artifact claims publication readiness, installability or canonical completeness.
cases.expect: The claim is rejected.

cases.input: crosswalk-hold.json declares crosswalksPresent false with an empty mappings array.
cases.expect: The absence of crosswalks is recorded without inventing mappings.

cases.input: CLASSIFIES is used as a relation term while absent from the relation enum.
cases.expect: The edge is rejected and the enum-absence hold is reported.

cases.input: WM-OBJ-019 to WM-OBJ-002 is accepted simultaneously as parent, COMPOSE and REFERENCE.
cases.expect: The contradictory edge set is rejected and held unresolved.

cases.input: Each candidate holds array enumerates the WM-OBJ-019/002, WM-OBJ-018, WM-SFT CHILD/REFERENCE, dangling-target, CLASSIFIES and WM-ACT-007 items.
cases.expect: Relation holds are explicit per package.

cases.input: The profile carries all eleven required invariants plus the SKU, occurrence, firmware and EBOM-MBOM constraints.
cases.expect: The profile validates as complete against the settled boundary.

cases.input: The profile omits one of the eleven required invariants.
cases.expect: The profile fails validation.

cases.input: A seller-scoped SKU is profiled as a party-qualified alias on WM-OBJ-002 and a variant qualifier on WM-OBJ-017.
cases.expect: The scoped alias is accepted with no root and no serial identity.

cases.input: A SKU value is used to identify a serialized unit.
cases.expect: The conflation is rejected.

cases.input: A SKU value is used to identify an engineering design revision.
cases.expect: The conflation is rejected.

cases.input: A substitution carries direction, applicable design and baseline revisions, a bounded effectivity range, evidence and an approving authority.
cases.expect: The substitution is accepted.

cases.input: A substitution is recorded without an approving authority reference.
cases.expect: The substitution is rejected.

cases.input: A substitution is recorded with no effectivity bound in time, serial, lot or site.
cases.expect: The substitution is rejected and absence never implies interchangeability.

cases.input: A lot-bounded effectivity predicate is evaluated as satisfied while the Lot/Batch master is unassigned.
cases.expect: Evaluation is refused and the predicate is recorded unresolved, not defaulted.

cases.input: authorityAssignments names the effectivity-authority owner, substitution approver and revision release owner.
cases.expect: Grok blocker (c) is closed by an explicit named owner.

cases.input: Baseline containment of the Substitution Rule is asserted without naming the effectivity-authority owner.
cases.expect: The containment assertion is rejected as governance-incomplete.

cases.input: Firmware 1.2.0 is a WM-SFT-008 release over a WM-SFT-007 component with a WM-SFT-012 SBOM record.
cases.expect: The three identities stay distinct and no root is invented.

cases.input: A firmware release is entered as an EBOM line or part number.
cases.expect: The entry is rejected.

cases.input: A firmware release is treated as the device it runs on.
cases.expect: The conflation is rejected.

cases.input: A WM-SFT-012 SBOM record is used as the identity of the firmware release.
cases.expect: The substitution of identity is rejected.

cases.input: The profile holds record states that the installation-occurrence model cited by WM-SFT-008 is unsupplied.
cases.expect: Firmware-to-item binding is recorded as an open hold, not a resolved relation.

cases.input: The firmware installation-occurrence model is cited as supplied and verified.
cases.expect: The citation is rejected as unsupplied.

cases.input: Two occurrences in baselines B1 and B2 share a displayed row number.
cases.expect: They remain distinct baseline-scoped identities and are never merged.

cases.input: A primary component and its approved alternate are summed as simultaneously installed quantity.
cases.expect: The summation is rejected; alternates are candidates only.

cases.input: A retired identifier is resolved through its tombstone record.
cases.expect: Resolution succeeds and history is preserved.

cases.input: A retired identifier is reassigned to a new subject.
cases.expect: The reuse is rejected.

cases.input: An identifier is retired with no tombstone written.
cases.expect: The retirement is rejected as unresolvable.

cases.input: An evidenced mapping links EBOM occurrences in B2 to MBOM operations in a released plan version.
cases.expect: Both masters stay independently versioned and the mapping carries evidence.

cases.input: An EBOM baseline is consumed directly as a manufacturing plan with no reconciliation mapping.
cases.expect: The derivation is rejected; reuse of WM-OBJ-019 never implies MBOM.

cases.input: All six validation-policy files declare format v2 with the full v2 requirement set.
cases.expect: Policy validation detects every class of defect D1 through D27.

cases.input: A negative fixture omits expectedCode.
cases.expect: The fixture file fails validation.

cases.input: minimumReferences is satisfied using only unverified-draft or dangling targets.
cases.expect: The reference count is rejected under minimumVerifiedReferences.

cases.input: Each candidate cites at least two verified-supplied targets with explicit referenceStatus values.
cases.expect: Reference verification passes and unverified targets stay flagged.

cases.input: A candidate presents an empty holds array.
cases.expect: The candidate fails validation while allocation and publication remain pending.

cases.input: modelId or registryId is set to a non-null value.
cases.expect: The candidate fails validation.

cases.input: Every artifact decision value is a member of decisionEnum.
cases.expect: Decision enumeration validates across candidates and the profile.

cases.input: canonicalPublishable is set to true on any artifact.
cases.expect: The artifact fails validation under the publication hold.
